-- Scout the arena
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local results = {}

-- Players
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if hrp then
        table.insert(results, string.format("PLAYER: %s at (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f) HP=%.0f",
            p.Name, hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z,
            hum and hum.Health or 0))
    else
        table.insert(results, "PLAYER: " .. p.Name .. " — no character")
    end
end

-- Enemies
for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("Model") and (obj.Name == "AerialHawk" or obj.Name == "Crawler" or obj.Name == "Titan") then
        local hrp = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp then
            table.insert(results, string.format("ENEMY %s at (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f) HP=%.0f",
                obj.Name, hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z,
                hum and hum.Health or 0))
        end
    end
end

-- Pickups
for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("Part") and string.sub(obj.Name, 1, 7) == "Pickup_" then
        table.insert(results, string.format("PICKUP %s at (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f)",
            obj.Name, obj.Position.X, obj.Position.Y, obj.Position.Z))
    end
end

return table.concat(results, "\n")
